title: Five-Hessian positive native transverse response
summary: Fit positive common-chart SAM kernels with a TS-whitened matrix exponential in bounded inverse-fourth bond progress; preserve the distinct scalar and molecular qualification gates.
gates: Five fixed off-TS Hessian centers plus the TS kernel; no source acquisition
Frozen nonredundant SMITH native coordinate definition and common TS oscillator scaling
Disjoint exhaustive SAM and independent LAM sectors; no curvature clipping
Largest declared ridge meeting a 10 cm^-1 physical kernel-element tolerance; no rate tuning
Positive matrix-exponential response; no claim of identified purely transverse cubic or quartic derivatives
Kernel acceptance does not qualify the scalar potential or molecular rates
Protect source E/G/H and TS four-jet in the downstream scalar model
Require all original kinetic nodes, invariant derivatives and rate step convergence below one percent
Retain shared regularized Wang-Landau, analytic-fit DVR and rotational convolution
Execute only on the declared verified remote host
coordinate_policy: Common TS-scaled native SAM coordinates; LAM excluded from the kernel and retained in independent DVR sectors.
backend_policy: Resident kernel fit only; no electronic jobs, source acquisition or choice of electronic level.
